subject.title: Make the Crabbox skill portable and sync the ClawSweeper snapshot

question: Should agent-skills own a portable Crabbox policy plus a minimal snapshot format, while each downstream repository owns its adapter, pin, verification, and pull-request updater?
rationale: The required split determines what belongs in this shared-skills repository versus ClawSweeper, and it defines the credentials and compatibility guarantees for cross-repository automation.

options.title: Adopt a narrow shared contract
options.body: Keep generic policy and a documented snapshot format here; let each downstream repository own its pin, adapter, validation, and PR-only update workflow.

options.title: Keep skills installation-only
options.body: Require downstream repositories to install or symlink the canonical skill and do not support zero-setup vendored snapshots.

options.title: Create central distribution automation
options.body: Build a centrally managed multi-repository updater, accepting the additional ownership, permissions, and compatibility obligations.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow shared contract
recommendation.body: Keep generic policy and a documented snapshot format here; let each downstream repository own its pin, adapter, validation, and PR-only update workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The member-authored issue supplies the concrete cross-repository constraints and is the best available owner for clarifying the intended contract.
